mtl_class = "MaterialPhysicalStandard"

# Naming
suffix = "_mtl"
lowercase = True

geo = ix.selection[0].get_module()

print("Found shading groups: " + str(geo.get_shading_group_count()))
if geo.get_shading_group_count():
    target_ctx = ix.api.IOHelpers.pick_context(ix.application, "Target location for Material Contexts")
    for i in range(geo.get_shading_group_count()):
        shading_group = str(geo.get_shading_group(i))
        print("Creating context for: " + str(shading_group))
        mtl_ctx = ix.cmds.CreateContext(str(shading_group), "Global", str(target_ctx))
        mtl_name = str(shading_group) + suffix
        if lowercase:
            mtl_name = mtl_name.lower()
        mtl = ix.cmds.CreateObject(mtl_name, mtl_class, "Global", str(mtl_ctx))
        geo.assign_material(mtl.get_module(), i)
